verdict: WATCH 5/10 (light court 2026-07-31, pipeline v1.6). The court's headline: the triage's bear tell is REFUTED and the triage's bull premise is REPRICED. (A) INSIDER FORENSICS (EDGAR Form 4s, primary): every Sanghi sale — 738,744 sh / ~$64.4M gross across six S-filings Jan-22 to May-1-2026, MORE than the triage's $44.7M — was under ONE Rule 10b5-1 plan adopted 2025-06-06 (checked box + adoption-date footnote on all six), sales began ~7.5mo post-adoption, escalating clips into rising prices = a price-tiered ladder; 7.4% of the pre-sale stake; the Family LP line (5.9M sh, 63% of holdings) untouched; ~9.41M sh (~$880M+) retained; ZERO sales since May-1 (plan exhaustion); wavg exit $87.15 = 16% ABOVE spot. This is pre-committed diversification by a 71-year-old, not an information-driven exit — the 'founder selling = window closed' framing FAILS. Residual amber: COO Simoncic sold 20k sh at $93-98 with NO 10b5-1 flag (only discretionary seller, small), and an unread 2026-07-24 8-K item 5.02 (officer/comp) needs a look. (B) v2 CLOCK: seat-date 7q is the WRONG clock — v2 clocks from kitchen-sink completion (Dec-2024 Fab-2 closure + 2,000 cuts -> Mar-2025 trough guide) = ~5.3q in, technically inside the ~8q window; but the trough entry rung (0.5-1.5q post-reset, mid-2025 at $50-60) is long gone and the multiple re-rate is DONE: 17.9x fwd is already the ADI/TXN-discount-normal recovered multiple, and on the Jun-26 guide annualized (~$2.76 non-GAAP EPS run-rate) spot is ~27x — the market has PRE-PAID the remaining recovery. What genuinely remains unfixed (real, but capitalized): GM 61.6% non-GAAP vs the 65-68% Sanghi-era norm (3-5pp of utilization recapture, fabs ramping); revenue $1,311M/qtr = only ~57% of the $2.29B peak (guide mid $1,456M = 64%); internal inventory 185 DOI vs ~130-150 norm (distributor channel ALREADY lean at 26 days = the restock tailwind); net debt ~$5.4B + $1.4B 7.5% mandatory convert (MCHPP) + a ~$980M/yr dividend held through the trough. (C) VALUATION: prob-weighted FV $73 (30/50/20) vs spot $74.95 = ZERO edge at spot; the stock also just ROUND-TRIPPED a June run to $105.91 (-29% in weeks, 13w low 71.24) — the tape has already played and faded the recovery trade once. (D) AI-OVERLAY: NOT a diversifier — no crash-benefit channel, full SOXX-membership beta (the July drawdown alongside the AI complex despite zero AI-capex revenue is the live demonstration: unrelated fundamentals, correlated tape), second-order industrial/auto-MCU recession exposure if the break spreads, and none of the AI earnings torque that supports ADI/TXN multiples; under the ensemble's P(break by end-2027)~0.46 (3 RED / 4 AMBER, 2026-07-31 run) MCHP wears the beta and collects none of the boom -> bear-weight input, not a hedge. TAXONOMY: valuation finding -> price gate (the one sanctioned gate case); TINA checked and does NOT apply (levered mid-recovery cyclical under a 46% complex-break overlay with FV at/below spot is not fairly-valued-quality-dead-money). The v2 prior 'late-window entries don't pay' is UPHELD at spot — but for the RIGHT reason (the re-rate is pre-paid), not the triage's reason (the insider tell, which the court struck down).

Weights 30/50/20 -> $73.1 vs spot $74.95 = edge -2%. FAIR AT SPOT. court_rulings.Q1_v2_clock_and_whats_unfixed: Clock re-based per v2: kitchen-sink = Dec-2024 restructuring (Fab 2 closure, 2,000 cuts, guide rebased) completing at the Mar-2025 trough (rev $970.5M, GAAP GM 51.6%) -> ~5.3 quarters elapsed, INSIDE the ~8q Adidas-math window on the letter of the rule. But the window's PAYOUT is the re-rate, and the re-rate has happened: trough $47.79 (Apr-2025) -> +57% at spot, multiple back to recovered-normal. Remaining unfixed and REAL: (1) GM 61.6% non-GAAP vs 65-68% norm — utilization recapture as fabs ramp, guided 62.25-63.25% next q, the cleanest observable; (2) rev at 57-64% of the $2.29B/q peak — though part of that peak was double-ordering, full round-trip is NOT the base case; (3) internal DOI 185 vs ~130-150 norm (channel already lean: distributor 26 days); (4) deleverage: $5.4B net debt + $1.4B MCHPP 7.5% pref, down from $6.75B peak. All four are levers a HOLDER gets paid on via EPS; none of them re-rates a 17.9x multiple that already assumes their capture.

Six S-filings, one plan (adopted 2025-06-06, pre-dating the Nov-2025 run), aff10b5One=1 on every filing, 7.4% of stake, FLP intact, no sales in ~3 months, wavg $87.15 > spot. Accessions 0001181928-26-000004/-000006/-000010/-000018/-000020; latest Form 4 (0001181928-26-000028, 2026-07-06) is grants-only. Court rule going forward: the LIVE tell is a NEW plan adopted at/below spot, any discretionary (unflagged) Sanghi sale, or FLP-line movement — those, not the exhausted ladder, would reopen the bear. CFO Bjornholt: small quarterly 10b5-1 sales, benign. COO Simoncic: 20k sh at $93-98 UNFLAGGED = the one discretionary datum, minor. UNVERIFIED: the 2026-07-24 8-K item 5.02 (officer/comp) — read it before any add.
court_rulings.Q3_valuation_vs_analog_semis: 17.9x fwd sits at the historical MCHP discount to ADI 24.5x / TXN 26.6x (their premia carry real AI/DC content and fortress balance sheets MCHP lacks), above ON 19.3x... nominally cheap-vs-peers but NOT cheap-vs-itself: on annualized current-guide EPS (~$2.76) spot is ~27x, i.e. the 17.9x IS the recovered multiple discounting FY28 recapture EPS ~$4.20. NXPI at 12.8x fwd is the cheaper cyclical if one wants the exposure. The June tape answered the question empirically: at $105.91 MCHP briefly traded ~25x fwd (full), round-tripped -29%. Conclusion: the re-rate leg of the great-man trade is consumed; what's on offer at spot is fairly-priced EPS-through with semis beta.
court_rulings.Q4_ai_break_overlay: NOT A DIVERSIFIER. Test: a diversifier needs a benefit-or-immunity channel in the break scenario. MCHP has neither — (a) index/complex membership: SOXX constituent, correlation goes to 1 in the drawdown (July 2026 live proof: -29% alongside the AI complex on zero AI-capex revenue); (b) second-order: an AI break that tightens credit/capex hits industrial+auto MCU demand — MCHP's core — mid-recovery; (c) it collects NONE of the boom while wearing the beta (DC/AI content = storage controllers, CXL, PCIe Gen6 retimers, unquantified small %). Ensemble 2026-07-31: 0 GREEN / 4 AMBER / 3 RED, P(break by end-2027) median 0.46, by end-2028 0.74 -> feeds the 30% bear weight and kill trigger 5. Classification: UNRELATED-FUNDAMENTALS/CORRELATED-TAPE — treat as semis beta for sizing, never as a hedge.

red_team_self: COUNTER 1 — 'you cleared the insider tell too fast: a price-TIERED ladder is still the founder choosing prices to sell at': PARTLY FAIR. The plan structure implies he pre-committed to selling into the $80s-90s, i.e. he judged those prices full a year ago — and spot is $75. But the counter cuts BOTH ways: the plan STOPPED (no tier below ~$88 apparently armed... or price fell below remaining limits), and 92.6% of the stake is still riding. A founder who thought the window was closed does not leave $880M long. Net: tell weak, correctly struck.

COUNTER 2 — 'your base case IS the bull half of consensus: FY28 $4.20 EPS needs GM 64-65% which has NOT printed': CONCEDED as the reason the score is 5 and not 6. The GM guide (62.25-63.25%) still sits 2-5pp below the norm; every quarter of recapture is observable. This is why the band requires an UNIMPAIRED path and why kill trigger 1 is the sharpest knife.

COUNTER 3 — 'the great_man framework does not even apply: founder-RETURN with recovery confirmed is the SBUX validation shape, not an entry shape': UPHELD IN SPIRIT. Sanghi is a D1-partial per the grounding doc (builder's record, not a distress-rescue record; the turnaround he executed here IS now the demonstrated instance). The court grades this name into the cohort for the Brier record, but the archetype's tradeable moment was mid-2025. MCHP enters the ledger as what it now is: a fairly-priced recovery cyclical with a band — the cohort tag preserves the lesson, not a live archetype claim.

COUNTER 4 — 'FV weights are vibes: 30% bear leans on an ensemble median (0.46) whose members disagree 0.30-0.86': FAIR — the range is the honest output. Sensitivity: bear 20% -> FV $76 (spot-fair); bear 40% -> $70 (-7%). The verdict (WATCH, band below spot) is stable across the range; only a <15% bear weight makes spot a buy, and that requires overruling 3 RED ensemble members.
